summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Evaxion A/S, a Danish clinical-stage biotech, furnishing a press release with a business update and Q1 2026 financial results. No special situation event — no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The release highlights operational milestones, AI-immunology data, and cash runway into H2 2027. Management changes (promotion of Birgitte Røn, election of Jens Bitsch-Nørhave) are routine organizational adjustments, not forced departures. Therefore, this is not a special situation; the category is None.
